81
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 11, 2005/Sravana 20, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy; Coal;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Ocean Development; Overseas Indian Affairs; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science and Technology; Shipping, Road
Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions —20
Road link to Myanmar
*261. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to take initiative in extending
road-links to Myanmar across the North-
Eastern States according to the 'look east'
policy;
(b) if so, the response received from
other countries; and
(c) if not, whether any other similar
programme is being contemplated?
 Directors in Neyveli Lignite
Corporation
*262. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Board of
directors of Public Sector Undertakings are
to consist of 50 per cent directors and non-
executive directors but in the Neyveli
Lignite Corporation (NLC) there was only
one independent director on its board as
has been reported by C&AG in its report
No. 4 of 2003 (PSUs);
(b) if so, the reasons for violating SEBI's
rule and the steps taken to rectify the
mistakes and to fix the responsibility of
the authority concerned for their being no
non-executive director; and
(c) the details of other observations
made by C&AG regarding NLC and the
action taken thereon?
 Contribution for earthquake
rehabilitation from
MPLADS fund
*263. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
Will the Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount collected by way of
contributions made by Rajya Sabha MPs

82
for earthquake rehabilitation works in
Gujarat from their MPLADS funds;
(b) the details of works carried out by
HUDCO and NBCC and the amount spent
as on the 30th June, 2005 by these agencies;
(c) whether ten Community Halls in
Wankaner Taluka villages were sanctioned
and work orders given by NBCC;
(d) if so, the progress made in the
construction of those Community Halls;
and
(e) the amount lying with HUDCO,
NBCC and the Ministry, with interest as
on the 30th June, 2005, out of the collection
made?
 Impact of tsunami
*264. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of SCIENCE
AND TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any scientific analysis has
been carried out for ascertaining the impact
and havoc brought by the recent tsunami in
the country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) the measures that are contemplated
to forecast tsunami and such other disasters
in future and to meet the challenges thrown
by such disasters in the future;
(d) whether experts have suggested
creating mangroves on the shores to
minimize the impact of tsunami; and
(e) if so, the details in this regard and
Government's reaction thereto?
 Tokyo-led Asian Broad Band
Programme
*265. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
Japan have signed an MoU for participation
of India in the Tokyo-led Asian Broad Band
Programme; and
(b) if so, the details of the agreement?
 Water harvesting
*266. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that it is proposed
to make water harvesting a part of
MPLADS to control water crisis in the
country;
(b) if so, the details of the action plan;
and
(c) how far this would help to address
this issue?
 Upgradation of Telephone Exchanges
in Mizoram
*267. SHRI LALHMING LIANA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Telephone Exchanges
with their capacity in the State of Mizoram
and the exchanges which are earmarked for

83
upgradation during the current financial
year;
(b) whether BSNL is contemplating to
cover the whole State of Mizoram with
WLL during the financial year 2005-06; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
 National Ship Design and Research
Institute
*268. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the present role of the NSDRI in
Vishakhapatnam;
(b) the funding provided by
Government to the NSDRI over the last
three years, year-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that the work
load and work output of NSDRI is totally
inadequate;
(d) whether Government propose to
wind up the Institute;
(e) if so, whether Government would
hand over the NSDRI to Andhra
University; and
(f) if not, the reasons for funding of
NSDRI?
 War against terrorism by Pakistan

the

National Programme on Rural
Industrialisation
1884. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the present status of National
Programme on Rural Industrialisation in the
State of Assam;
(b) the details of the allocation of funds
made by Government during the last three
years and whether it has been fully spent
by the State; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Ban on technology and materials
1885. SHRI B. K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India’s inability to expand
its present nuclear power generation
capacity, which cover only 3 per cent of
our total requirements is due to inadequate
supplies of uranium and technological
assistance coupled with embargo by a cartel
called Nuclear Suppliers Group (NSG);
(b) whether the NSG operates a blanket
ban on technology and materials trade with
black-listed countries, including India; and
(c) if so, whether US has offered civilian
nuclear energy co-operation with India
which could lead the NSG to reconsider
the ban currently in force?
Accident in CCL mine in Hazaribagh
1886. SHRI LALIT SURI:
SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN:
Will the  PRIME  MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of workers got
trapped inside the Central Coal Fields Ltd.
(CCL) Saunda mine in Hazaribagh on the
14th June, 2005;
(b) the number, out  of them, who lost
their lives and those who could be rescued;
(c) whether the cause of the accident
has been investigated; if so, the findings
thereof and the action taken thereon;

428
(d) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to prevent such mishaps; and
(e) the nature of assistance given to the
families of those who lost their lives in the
mishap?
Outsourcing of coal
1887. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the  PRIME  MINISTER be
pleased to state the total output of coal
through outsourcing by Coal India Limited
and its subsidiaries during the last three
years?
IPO by Coal India Limited
1888. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will  the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
and Coal India Limited are considering an
IPO to part finance its Rs. 21,000/- crores
investment plans; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
E-auction by MCL
1889. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Mahanadi
Coal fields Limited has launched e-auction
of coal meant for non-core consumers, as
against the open sale scheme;
(b) whether it has been resented by the
Orissa Coal Consumers Association, as
majority of the coal users do not have access
to computers and therefore they cannot
bid on the internet;
(c) if so, whether their grievances have
been redressed; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Coal shortage
1890. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the  PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is an acute shortage of
coal supply in the country, more so in
Orissa;
(b) if so, whether as a result of this
industrial production of iron, steel and other
metals have been affected severely; and
(c) what are the reasons for this shortage
despite a vast reserve of coal of 250 billion
tonnes and lignite of 36 billion tonnes in
the country?
Loading work in Gevara/Dipka mines
†1891. SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the work of loading in
Gevara/Dipka coal mines of SECL has been
entrusted to ESM (Ex-servicemen)
companies;
(b) if so, the names of these companies;
(c) the amount paid to these companies
under loading/unloading head during the last
three years; and
(d) the rate of loading with a Surface
Miner Machine and the rate paid to the
ESM companies?
Restoration of SECL area
†1892. SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) the total area of SECL sector restored

with sand and soil filling and plantation
after the mining of the coal during last five
years;
(b) the total area yet to be filled up;
(c) the plan for making alternate use of
filled up area;
(d) whether such land would be handed
over to its original owners for making better
use of it; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Fixation of royalty on coal
